items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX lose over $420 billion in combined market cap after midterms
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，美国中期选举后特斯拉与SpaceX合计市值蒸发逾4200亿美元，反映市场对其增长前景及政治关联风险的重估。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk says Tesla must refund Cybertruck deposits to ‘a lot of people’; he touted 250K reservations back in 2019
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，马斯克确认特斯拉需要向大量客户退还Cybertruck订金，暴露其需求及交付预期的不确定性。

items.text: Elon Musk Confirms ‘Global Bankruptcy’ Fears As Tesla And SpaceX Explore Bitcoin Price Game-Changer
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，马斯克确认特斯拉与SpaceX正研究比特币的“游戏规则改变者”应用，并称全球破产担忧具有现实性。

items.author: Burry
items.text: Michael Burry trims Caterpillar bearish bet after puts nearly quadruple (CAT:NYSE)

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX is competing for NASA’s $10 billion in contracts to build a moon base
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，SpaceX正竞逐NASA价值100亿美元的月球基地合同，订单落地将显著影响其商业航天业务。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Says SpaceX Sales Are ‘Exploding’—and Forecasts Revenue Twice Wall Street’s Estimate
items.summary_cn: 据媒体报道，马斯克称SpaceX销售额正在“爆发”，并预计收入将达到华尔街预测的两倍。

items.author: 洪灏
items.text: 內地頻出招救市 大行：釋維穩信號 待流動性改善企業盈利回升始確認觸底 - 20261109 - 經濟
items.summary_cn: 据报道，洪灏指出内地频繁推出救市措施释放了维稳信号，但企业盈利回升及流动性改善仍需确认触底。

items.author: Trump
items.text: I am proud to announce that David MacNeil, the GREAT American entrepreneur and founder of WeatherTech, will be the Special Envoy for Manufacturing! David has built an incredible American company that makes outstanding products, RIGHT HERE IN THE U.S.A. He knows how to create jobs, bring Manufacturing back home, and put America First. Together, we will bring back American jobs, strengthen our factories, and make sure that future products are MADE IN AMERICA. Congratulations David — Your unparalleled expertise is vitally needed! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: 特朗普任命WeatherTech创始人David MacNeil为制造业特使，政策重心聚焦制造业回流、就业和“美国制造”。

items.author: 段永平
items.text: 跌市只買盤數能算明白的公司
items.summary_cn: 据报道，段永平在跌市中只买入自身能够算清业务及盘数逻辑的公司，体现其谨慎的逆向投资原则。
